{{Quote|If we can get the Ansionians to commit to pulling out of the Republic, no one will really care. But because of their alliances, their withdrawal should be enough to sway their already vacillating partners in both the Malarian Alliance and the Keitumite Treaty to follow.|Shu Mai|<ref name="AS" />}}
The '''Keitumite Mutual Military Treaty''' was a treaty signed by representatives from seven [[star system/Legends|systems]], including [[Ansion system/Legends|Ansion]], [[Keitum system/Legends|Keitum]], [[Mondress system/Legends|Mondress]], [[Lonnaw]], [[Dorin/Legends|Dorin]], [[Eeropha]], and [[Glom Tho]], prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="AS" />

The Military Treaty joined the worlds in both commerce and defense. While the treaty had never actually been invoked, it remained in force during the years following the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. During the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]] attempted to force [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]] to secede from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]&mdash;hoping that the others, bound by their respective treaties, would follow suit, and thus add more planets and [[Star system/Legends|systems]] to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] cause.<ref name="AS" />
